def_en: 1) to sojourn, abide, dwell in, dwell with, remain, inhabit, be a stranger, be continuing, surely
1a1) to sojourn, dwell for a time
2) to stir up trouble, strife, quarrel, gather together
3) to dread, fear, stand in awe, be afraid
3a2) to be in awe, stand in awe
kjv: abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, [idiom] surely.
expl: properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid)
